Frequently Asked Questions (Shopify Profit Calc)

What is a healthy net profit margin for a Shopify DTC store in 2026?

Healthy Shopify brands target 60%–75% gross margin before ads and 15%–25% net profit margin after shipping, payment processing, returns, and paid customer acquisition (Meta/TikTok/Google Ads).

Why should Shopify sellers model a 2%–5% return reserve?

Even low-return niches experience damaged packages, chargebacks, or size exchanges. Building a 3% return reserve into per-order pricing prevents silent profit leaks at scale.
